title: Chain Lube Interval Breach
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).
app: Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rever:ride bike_id=* odometer_km=*
| eventstats max(eval(if(chain_lube_performed="yes",odometer_km,null()))) as last_lube_odo by bike_id
| stats max(odometer_km) as current_odo, max(last_lube_odo) as last_lube_odo by bike_id
| eval km_since_lube=round(current_odo-last_lube_odo,1)
| where km_since_lube>500
| sort - km_since_lube
description: Flags bikes that have exceeded their preferred distance interval since the last recorded chain lube event.
value: Chain care is classic maintenance debt: a tiny repeating task that gets expensive when it is skipped.
implementation: Annotate REVER ride events or periodic maintenance notes with `chain_lube_performed=yes` and current odometer.
visualization: Table of bikes by kilometres since last chain lube.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks which bike chains have gone too long without attention.
